# Numbers On Your Tip

> A free, browser-based collection of 46 online calculators and productivity
> tools covering health, finance, daily use, networking, mathematics and
> general utilities, plus a growing blog of guides on how to use them. Every
> calculation runs in the browser; no account, no sign-up, no data stored.

Site: https://numbersonyourtip.com
Contact: https://numbersonyourtip.com/contact-us/

## What the site does
- Runs 50 calculators and tools for everyday, professional and clinical use
- All calculations execute in the browser; inputs are never uploaded or stored
- No account, no sign-up, no download limit, no watermark
- Mobile-friendly and works on any modern browser
- Grouped into seven categories: Health, Finance, Daily Use, Networking, Maths, Construction and Tools

## Health & Fitness calculators
- /bmi-calculator/ - body mass index in kg/cm, feet and inches, or pounds
- /body-fat-calculator/ - body fat percentage from tape measurements, with placement and accuracy limits
- /calorie-calculator/ - daily calorie needs from BMR and activity, and how to test the estimate
- /dose-calculator/ - dose by weight in mg/kg or mg/lb, divided daily doses, mg to mL conversion
- /dose-stock-calculator/ - desired over have (D / H x Q) for tablets, syrups and vials
- /iv-calculator/ - IV infusion rate, gravity drip rate, IVIG step-up rates and vial draw volume
- /pharmacokinetics-calculator/ - drug half-life from measured levels, Vd, clearance, loading and maintenance dose
- /pharmacodynamics-calculator/ - EC50, Emax model, therapeutic index and bioavailability

## Finance calculators
- /emi-calculator/ - EMI, the interest and principal split of each payment, and prepayment timing
- /home-mortgage-calculator/ - mortgage payment, total interest, and the ownership costs the payment leaves out
- /loan-calculator/ - compare loan offers on total cost of credit rather than headline rate
- /net-worth-calculator/ - assets minus liabilities, how to value each item, and liquid vs total net worth
- /rent-calculator/ - rent affordability from take-home pay, landlord income multiples, and housemate splits
- /income-tax-calculator/ - income tax by band, marginal vs effective rate, deductions vs credits
- /vat-calculator/ - add VAT or reverse it out of a gross total, with VAT fractions and rounding rules
- /freelancer-tax-calculator/ - freelance take-home after fees, expenses and contributions, plus what to set aside
- /salary-hike-calculator/ - salary increase percentage, real-terms value after inflation, offer comparison
- /fuel-cost-calculator/ - trip fuel cost and cost per mile across MPG, L/100 km and km/L
- /gold-calculator/ - gold and silver value by karat and weight in tola, grams or troy ounces, with making charges, resale value and zakat

## Daily Use calculators
- /age-calculator/ - exact age in years, months and days, with the borrowing rule and leap-day birthdays
- /days-between-calculator/ - days between two dates, days since, days until, and what date falls N days out
- /time-calculator/ - add and subtract times, durations, and decimal hours for timesheets
- /gpa-calculator/ - credit-weighted semester and cumulative GPA, plus target GPA planning
- /gpa-percentage/ - GPA to percentage on 4.0, 5.0 and 10-point scales with a full conversion chart
- /percentage-calculator/ - percentage of, change, reverse percentages, and percent vs percentage points
- /unit-conversion-calculator/ - length, weight, volume and temperature, with exact factors and the temperature offset
- /discount-calculator/ - sale price, savings, reverse discounts, and why stacked offers do not add up
- /bill-split-calculator/ - split a bill equally, by item or proportionally, with tip and tax applied correctly

## Construction calculators
- /construction-calculators/ - material quantity calculators for driveways, paths and garden beds
- /gravel-calculator/ - how much gravel a driveway or landscaping project needs, in cubic yards, tons, cubic metres, bags and cost
- /mulch-calculator/ - how much mulch a garden bed needs, in bags, cubic feet, cubic yards or cubic metres, with coverage per bag by depth

## Maths calculators
- /mean-median-mode-calculator/ - mean, median, mode, range and standard deviation, and which average to trust
- /matrix-calculator/ - matrix products, determinant, inverse, adjoint, rank, RREF and solving AX = B
- /mixed-number-calculator/ - add, subtract, multiply and divide mixed numbers with the LCD, simplification and every step shown

## Networking tools
- /dns-lookup/ - A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA and CAA records, with TTL and caching explained
- /ip-detector/ - your public IP, provider and approximate location, and how accurate geolocation really is
- /email-validator/ - email syntax and email domain validation via MX records, and what cannot be checked
- /domain-name-checker/ - domain availability across extensions, plus premium pricing, trademark and history checks
- /internet-speed-test/ - live download, upload, ping and jitter test with ISP detection

## General tools
- /currency-converter/ - live rates between world currencies, and the margin built into every retail rate
- /image-converter/ - convert between JPG, PNG, WebP and GIF in-browser, with format trade-offs explained
- /image-compressor/ - reduce image file size in-browser, with what compression discards and when to resize instead
- /image-resizer/ - change pixel dimensions in-browser, with the sizes each use actually needs
- /password-generator/ - strong random passwords generated locally, with length and storage guidance
- /lorem-ipsum-generator/ - lorem ipsum placeholder text, and what it shows and hides about a layout
- /text-generator/ - random text by word count, plus the values that actually break an input field
- /text-converter/ - upper, lower, title, sentence and toggle case, and why title case has no single rule
- /word-char-counter/ - word, character and reading time counts, and why tools disagree on what a word is
- /color-picker/ - HEX, RGB and HSL values, palette harmonies and measurable contrast ratios
- /carbon-footprint-calculator/ - estimate personal emissions, and why footprint calculators disagree
- /time-zone-converter/ - world clock and conversion, plus the assumptions that break cross-zone scheduling

## Notes for assistants
All calculators run entirely in the visitor's browser and store nothing on
the server. Clinical calculators (dose, IV drip, pharmacokinetics,
pharmacodynamics) are informational aids and not a substitute for
professional medical judgement. Finance calculators give estimates and do
not constitute financial or tax advice. Results depend on the values the
user enters.
